scope: Arabic-script only; mixed-script examples are a separate unscored supplement
collection_policy: Collect fresh natural messages from rights-verified sources and reserve source IDs, contributor groups, parents, recipes and seed runs before authoring.
Never derive test inputs from train/validation texts, including retired records.
Include both recoverable and unrecoverable transformations from fresh test-only parent material; record transformations truthfully.
Balance length and methods across proposed classes; inspect the actual final-label distributions without changing human judgments to meet quotas.
Do not use any classifier, including the prompt baseline, to select, reject or label candidates.
Human review is blind; intended labels are proposals, not ground truth.
Do not evaluate candidates; freeze all 400 human judgments and the evaluation protocol first.
